content.title: Feedback circle
content.summary: A facilitator guides a maker and responders through text feedback with permission before opinions.
content.setup: Invite a maker and responders, and name a facilitator who will advance each phase.
content.prompt: Share a work in progress and ask the group for feedback.
content.participant: Follow the current phase prompt. Request permission before posting an opinion.
content.completion: Read the feedback transcript and the maker’s permission decisions.
content.access: Everyone in the circle can read accepted text and decisions; the app does not assess tone or usefulness.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.

phasePrompts.meaning: Responders: say what caught your attention in the work.
phasePrompts.maker_questions: Maker: ask what you want to learn. Responders: answer the maker’s questions.
phasePrompts.neutral_questions: Responders: ask questions for the maker to answer.
phasePrompts.permissioned_opinions: Responders: name the topic of an opinion. Maker: grant or deny each request before any opinion is posted.
